accounting_note: Point-in-time observations from Netlify Billing. Not a live billing API connection. Update only from a verified current Netlify balance; never assume a monthly reset date.

snapshots.source: Owner-provided screenshot of Netlify Credit usage breakdown
snapshots.credit_period_label: Current billing period as shown; exact reset date not supplied

release_policy.budget_rule: Only one tested, deliberately batched production release per approved bundle. Do not publish at a reported balance below 15, on stale/unknown data, or if CI is failing. Keep provider privacy and recovery safeguards.
release_policy.manual_refresh_required: Refresh the latest Netlify team usage snapshot before release or after the billing cycle resets. Current Netlify connector does not expose the live billing balance.
release_policy.purchase_permission: No plan upgrades or credit purchases without the owner's separate approval.

reconciliation: After each confirmed Netlify publish, verify deploy SHA and refresh this ledger from Netlify's usage breakdown. A GitHub commit, deploy request or skipped build does not prove a billable Netlify production deploy.
